IS 12308 : Part 12 : 2025 Methods for Chemical Analysis of Cast Iron and Pig Iron - Part 12 Determination of Copper by Atomic Absorption Spectrometric Method (for Copper 0.01 Percent to 0.5 Percent)
ICS 77.080.10
ICS 77.080.10
MTD 34
MTD 34
1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 12) describes the method for determination of copper in pig iron and cast iron in the range from 0.01 percent to 0.5 percent by atomic absorption spectrometric method.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contains provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication the editions indicated were valid.
